headline: On October 17, 2023: Explosion at Gaza Hospital Kills Hundreds
captionCards: Explosion at Al-Ahli Arab Hospital killed hundreds of displaced Palestinians
The event highlights the vulnerability of civilians in conflict zones
instagramCaption:
Al-Ahli Arab Hospital in Gaza City was struck by tragedy.\nAn explosion in the courtyard of Al-Ahli Arab Hospital on October 17, 2023, during the Gaza war, resulted in the deaths and injuries of many displaced Palestinians seeking shelter. The event occurred in a place meant to provide safety and care, adding to its tragic impact.
